name: Torsher
description: Your home cinema in one container, built for the TV first

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The database and its keys (db/), downloads and the watch cache (torrents/) and the files you keep (library/). Keep them in this one folder so kept files are hard-linked, not copied.

paths.name: Zimaos
paths.description: Your existing movies and series, read-only. Add the folders inside it in the control panel under Library.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Torsher showcase (/), control panel (/panel/) and API, published on host as 6197

ports.name: Port 6198
ports.description: Torrent peer connections, TCP and UDP, published on host as 6198

ports.name: Port 6198
ports.description: Torrent peer connections, TCP and UDP, published on host as 6198

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: ENGINE_PEER_PORT
variables.description: The port torrent peers connect to. It must be the same number inside and outside the container. Leave it at 6198, and forward 6198 on your router for faster downloads.
